title: Commercial establishment processed successfully
description: Per-item success outcome of a Tangara commercial establishment batch registration/update. The payload carries the payment schemes and their bank domicile grouped in infos[]. One event is emitted per processed item to the commercial_establishment_processed_success event type. Produced by ce-api, the Tangara commercial establishment service, and not by the legacy commercial-establishment-api.

key.title: Key
key.description: Client-provided identifier of the commercial establishment item within the batch

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Client-assigned reference for the commercial establishment. Present only when supplied on creation

debtor.title: Debtor document number
debtor.description: Debtor (acquirer) document number that owns the commercial establishment

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: Document type derived from the commercial establishment document number. [CPF] [CNPJ]

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the commercial establishment is active

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Timestamp of the first persistence of the commercial establishment, in Brasilia time with the -03:00 offset

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update of the commercial establishment, in Brasilia time with the -03:00 offset

b3RegisteredAt.title: B3 registered at
b3RegisteredAt.description: Value of the request header b3-registered-at, returned unchanged. Omitted when the header is not sent

infos.title: Infos
infos.description: Groups of payment schemes with the bank domicile of the group

paymentSchemes.title: Payment schemes
paymentSchemes.description: Payment arrangement identifiers of the group, free text

bankAccount.title: Bank account
bankAccount.description: Bank domicile of the group of payment schemes

ispb.title: ISPB
ispb.description: Brazilian Payment System Identifier (ISPB) of the bank, zero-padded to 8 digits

documentNumber.title: Document number
documentNumber.description: Document number of the bank account holder

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: Document type derived from the bank account holder document number. [CPF] [CNPJ]

createdAt.title: Bank account created at
createdAt.description: Timestamp of the first persistence of the bank domicile, in Brasilia time with the -03:00 offset

updatedAt.title: Bank account updated at
updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update of the bank domicile, in Brasilia time with the -03:00 offset
